inputs.name: sourceRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root of Japanese Markdown source files; "." or "./" selects the repository root.

inputs.name: outputRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root for mirrored v2 Vietnamese Markdown and cache files.

inputs.name: glossary
inputs.description: Project terminology and translation rules read by the miss-only model step.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Repository-relative globs of source documents outside the v2 adoption backlog.

inputs.name: branches
inputs.description: Branches a person may run backfill on; also the bases of batch pull requests.

inputs.name: branchPrefix
inputs.description: Prefix for generated branches named <branchPrefix>/backfill-<batch id>.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used only for deterministic v2 cache misses.

inputs.name: batchSize
inputs.description: Maximum source documents attempted in one batch pull request.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Time limit in minutes for each miss-only model process.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum turns for each miss-only model process.

inputs.name: maxBudgetUsd
inputs.description: Runaway cost guard for each miss-only model process.

inputs.name: maxRepairs
inputs.description: Same-session repairs after the read-only result validator rejects output.

inputs.name: maxIterations
inputs.description: Maximum batch passes in one manual run.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Complete replacement for the trusted v2 backfill pipeline and miss-only skill.
